In this video, I travel to South Sudan, the world’s newest country, formed in 2011 after separating from Sudan. Known for its challenging conditions and limited infrastructure, it is one of the least visited and poorest countries by GDP per capita.
My journey begins with a small damaged plane to Juba, where filming itself is not easy. I explore the reality of life, along with the history, geography, and current situation of the country.
From the capital to everyday street life, this video shows a side of South Sudan that very few people get to see.
